nodes.title:
HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MODELS
Point UNETLoader / CLIPLoader / VAELoader at your own
Flux.2 Klein diffusion model, text encoder, and VAE files.

REFERENCES
Load up to 4 reference images into the LoadImage nodes on
the left; they're batched and fed into every enabled shot.

SHOTS
Toggle shots from the FACE SHOTS and BODY SHOTS panels
to the left of each row. F01-F03 start enabled; all other
shots start bypassed.

SAVING
Each shot's Preview Image Pixaroma node has save_mode set
to "save" and its own filename_prefix - no separate Save
Image node needed. Files land in ComfyUI's output folder.

RE-RUN
Change one prompt to request only that image again. Seeds are controlled by the SEED · Global Control node
(left of the graph). Default is randomize each run; switch
to fixed on that node to reproduce a specific image.
